messages:
mia: Pushed a quick Figma link with the compact release-history panel. Thinking: collapse long version lists into an accordion, surface latest canary % + a tiny sparkline. Screenshot attached (⬇️). Feedback please — especially a11y and microcopy.
ryan: nice! Can we keep the 'current live' vs 'canary' distinction visually obvious without color-only cues? worried about quick scannability in ops mode.
alex: agree re color-only. Suggest using a badge + icon and stronger border for current live. Also, performance: infinite scroll for history might be heavy. Prefer a 'show more' pagination.
sam: for the canary % control — current slider is animated; animation may interfere with keyboard adjusters. We should ensure arrow keys adjust by 1% and shift+arrows by 5%.
tara: +1 on keyboard granularity. Also saw that timeline entries aren't announced by NVDA when focused; need aria-live or role="list" semantics.
mia: notes: will change visual affordance: badge+icon + 1px stroke. For history, switching to 'show more' makes sense. On a11y I'll try role changes — any copy tweaks for the rollback CTA?
ryan: rollback copy: current is "Rollback to this version" — too blunt. How about: "Revert to version 2026.03.01 — app will restart" and secondary line: "Traffic and user sessions may be affected" ?
sam: prefer affirmative wording in confirm modal. Primary button: `Confirm revert` (danger style). Secondary: `Cancel`. Modal should show a diff of commit messages and the canary config.
tara: please include a keyboard-only path to open the diff and an option to copy the version ID. Screen-reader hint: "Press Enter to expand details".
alex: implementation note: large diffs may slow the modal. We can lazy-load diffs on expand. Also, consider an inline compact diff summary with a "View full diff" link.
mia: microcopy proposal for the modal body:

```
You are reverting to version v14.3.2 (deployed 2026-03-01).
This will re-route 100% of traffic to the selected version. Active sessions may be interrupted.
```

Buttons: [Cancel] [Confirm revert — Re-route traffic]

Thoughts?
ryan: looks good. Maybe swap the buttons order on mobile (primary full-width at bottom) and add a short reason field (optional) for audit logs.
tara: audit reason is helpful for QA signoffs. Also, add an aria-describedby linking to the diff summary.
alex: CSS nit — the canary slider's handle doesn't have a visible focus ring on mac Safari. Will add outline: 2px solid var(--focus) and high z-index.
sam: small UX: when a canary is paused (0% traffic), show a gray 'Paused' pill and action 'Resume -> set percent'. Avoid showing 0% as active.
mia: good call. I'll update the mocks: show Paused pill + tooltip "Paused by user · last change 22h ago".
deploy-bot: Canary deploy: service-search v14.3.3 started at 2026-03-12T14:02Z — currently receiving 10% of traffic in us-west. :rocket:
ryan: thanks bot. One more ask: add a lightweight 'why' hover on the canary %, explaining automated rollback triggers (latency, errors) and where to edit thresholds.
mia: adding that as an inline help icon with tooltip and a link to "Edit canary policy". I'll post updated frames in ~2h.
alex: LGTM; will prototype focus states and lazy diff loading. I'll flag the accessibility checklist for review once done. :eyes:
tara: I'll run screen-reader pass on staging after the prototype lands. Will log any a11y blockers in the ticket.
mia: thanks all — merging changes into the design branch. If anyone has microcopy tweaks after seeing frames ping me here. :tada:
